integrity: Analytic proof with independently evaluated age-integral and radial-Bessel integral and a deterministic reproducibility checker. Computational tests supplement, not replace, proofs.
scientific_limitations: Stationary identical-diffusivity Brownian gas with a single shared Poisson reset clock; no uniqueness of distance crossings, finite-time assertion, or next-order law at the critical mesoscopic constant.
title: An opposing-tail covariance transition in a synchronously reset Brownian gas
